services.desc: We offer 8 Hour inshore, 12 Hour offshore and 24 Hour offshore overnight charters so you can choose the perfect experience for you! Our 12-hour offshore trips will take you to the best fishing spots in the area for a full day of adventure, while our 8-hour inshore trips are perfect for those looking for a more casual experience. Our 24-hour Overnight trips are a great option for seasoned anglers who want to experience the "night bite" for many different pelagic species offered in the area. Our Captain and crew will ensure you have a safe and enjoyable fishing trip, so book your trip today! Yes! You may bring a small cooler for your beverages and food.
